messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging sabrina (oncall) — GPU pool pool-prod-gpu-12 is at 98% mem, queue length growing (avg wait 12s -> 43s), autoscaler at max replicas. Error spike: 500s and throttling observed. Root: http://grafana/redwood/graph?panel=gpupool-12
sabrina (oncall): on it. collecting quick snapshot. @mike can you grab the SRE handoff?

sabrina (oncall): summary from logs: token throughput up 2.8x last 30m, avg ctx len jumped from 1200 -> 6200 tokens on a subset of requests. KV-cache size per-host jumped ~5x. suspect model-v26 rollout that started ~35m ago.

anita (eng-runtime): confirmed — v26 rollout began at 1765547800 via canary->gradual. New beam prefill logic changed serializer and introduced always-on long-context prefetch (seen in traces). kv-index growth seen on the hot nodes.

mike (sre): copying the live metrics:
```
POOL: pool-prod-gpu-12
GPU_MEM_USED: 98.1%
QUEUE_LEN: 842 -> 2380 (30m)
AVG_LATENCY: 220ms -> 2.1s
AUTOSCALER_STATE: at_max_replicas (limit=24)
RECENT_ERRORS: tokenization-timeouts, kvcache OOM traces
```

mike (sre): autoscaler refused to scale further due to per-cluster quota + placement constraints. vendor quota request is pending (ticket 12345).

anita (eng-runtime): logs from model runtime show repeated KV cache warmups and large prefix caching for a tiny fraction of traffic causing wide spillover. snippet: 
```
[2025-11-05T14:12:34Z] prefill: user=svc-ingest-47 ctx=6312 prefetch_kv=true cache_alloc=12GB
[2025-11-05T14:12:36Z] kvcache: shard=7 evict_start -> fallback_to_disk
```

sabrina (oncall): immediate mitigations we can do now: 1) pause v26 rollout 2) apply system-level short-term rate-limit by route for high-ctx callers 3) add temporary model-variant fallback (v25) 4) open support banner and notify impacted customers. Which of these is fastest?

anita (eng-runtime): I can hit pause on the rollout now (deploy-bot, please run rollback-step for v26 canary). fallback to v25 should be trivial if we pin routes.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. Triggering pause-job:v26-canary at 1765550102.

mike (sre): while rollout pauses, we should also inject a routing policy to divert heavy-context requests to dedicated pool (if available) or to limit max_context param to 2048 for non-enterprise keys. I can push a temporary rate-limit rule in 2-3min.

ryan (eng-platform): I can add a routing policy but need the exact consumer groups. anita, can you dump the routes with highest ctx?

anita (eng-runtime): pulling top offending routes: svc-ingest-*, webhook-batch, external-replay. I'll push a patch to limit context and TTL for those keys.

liz (support): drafting customer message now. earliest affected customers appear to be 6 high-volume tenants showing 20-40% error increases. I need a short impact blurb and what mitigations we're applying.

sabrina (oncall): hotline plan: mike takes platform/infra, anita takes runtime/model rollback & pin, ryan does routing policy, liz sends customer-facing message. i'll coordinate and update status page.

mike (sre): mitigation step 1: apply ephemeral RBAC to allow autoscaler to request extra quota? Not allowed. Step 2: trigger emergency scale to spare pool -> coldstart of 4 gpus in us-west-2b (estimate 6-8 min). Initiating now.

mike (sre): emergency scale request submitted to cloud; warmup ETA ~7m. Also enabling aggressive preemption of batch jobs on pool-prod-gpu-12 to free ~15% mem.

anita (eng-runtime): rollback started: reassigning traffic from v26->v25 for canaries. Patching config: max_context=2048 for webhook-batch and svc-ingest-*; disable prefetch_kv flag.

sabrina (oncall): support blurb for liz: "We observed elevated latency and intermittent errors for some high-throughput tenants while we roll back a recent model variant. Mitigations in progress: rollback of v26, temporary routing limits, and scale-up of capacity. We will follow up with root cause and ETA. — Redwood Inference SRE"

liz (support): posted to status page and opened tickets to the six affected accounts. adding note: "possible degraded performance for high-context workloads; if you have SLA concerns ping support+sales"

deploy-bot: rollback complete for canary ring at 1765550648. Traffic shifting back to v25.

mike (sre): GPU pool mem down to 86% after preemption and rollback, queue len dropping to 340. Autoscaler still at max for replica count but effective load reduced.

anita (eng-runtime): runtime metrics: kvcache allocs stabilizing. prefetch disabled. still seeing some long tails from while the warmup spills to disk.

sabrina (oncall): good. next: followup actions — open incident ticket, run correlation eval on v26 to quantify ctx growth, schedule postmortem with eng-runtime + infra + product. Also get an ETA from vendor for quota increase (mike).

mike (sre): vendor replied: quota increase request acknowledged, tentative approval in 24-48h. For now we patch routing and keep v26 paused.

anita (eng-runtime): immediate root cause hypothesis: v26 introduced a prefill change that over-eagerly prefetches long prefixes for a small fraction of requests, causing disproportionate KV cache growth and per-request memory. Repro steps added to repo: /infra/incident-repros/v26-prefill.

sabrina (oncall): incident severity set to Sev2. notify execs? product wants a one-line as well.

ryan (eng-platform): I'll follow up tomorrow with a change to autoscaler policies to allow a small burst headroom and earlier eviction of idle cache shards.

liz (support): customers informed. creating RFC for opt-in of large-context routing so we can isolate heavy tenants to dedicated capacity in future.

sabrina (oncall): thanks everyone — keep channel updated with any regressions. I'll close the active paging when metrics hold for 30m and handoff to postmortem doc (link TBD). :thumbsup:
